name: weekly-review-sentiment
description: Every Monday, sums up last week's reviews in Slack: rating and sentiment against the previous four weeks, what customers praised and criticised most with a quote each, products that slipped, and anything new.

howItWorks.label: Trigger
howItWorks.text: Every Monday morning in your time zone

howItWorks.label: Compares
howItWorks.text: Last week's average rating and sentiment with the previous four weeks

howItWorks.label: Finds
howItWorks.text: The most praised and criticised topics, products whose reviews got worse, and new complaints

howItWorks.label: Posts
howItWorks.text: A short report to your Slack channel

howItWorks.label: Optional
howItWorks.text: Proposes a Linear issue for a new complaint, for you to approve
